findings.description: The KMS key does not set 'enable_key_rotation = true'. Without automatic key rotation, the same cryptographic material is used indefinitely, increasing the risk associated with key compromise and weakening the encryption posture for audit trail data.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default access
findings.description: No 'policy' attribute is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the root account and, by extension, any IAM principal with sufficiently broad IAM permissions. This can allow unintended IAM principals in the account to use or manage the key protecting audit trail data, weakening access control over sensitive encryption keys.
